name: close_terminal
description: Closes one terminal session and ends its process.

name: list_terminal_sessions
description: Lists the terminal sessions that are running in Terminator.

name: close_all_terminals
description: Closes every terminal session and ends their processes.

name: list_workspaces
description: Lists the workspaces in the Terminator sidebar.

name: create_workspace
description: Creates a workspace in the Terminator sidebar.

name: update_workspace
description: Changes the name, colour or other fields of a workspace.

name: delete_workspace
description: Deletes a workspace and its projects from Terminator.

name: reorder_workspaces
description: Sets the order of the workspaces in the sidebar.

name: list_projects
description: Lists the projects of a workspace.

name: create_project
description: Adds a project folder to a workspace.

name: delete_project
description: Removes a project from its workspace.

name: update_project_branch
description: Records the git branch that a project shows.

name: rename_project
description: Renames a project.

name: reorder_projects
description: Sets the order of the projects in a workspace.

name: is_git_repo
description: Tells whether a folder is a git repository.

name: current_branch
description: Returns the checked-out branch of a repository.

name: git_change_stats
description: Counts the changed files and lines in a repository.

name: list_branches
description: Lists the branches of a repository.

name: git_fetch
description: Fetches a repository from its remote.

name: git_checkout
description: Checks out a branch, which changes the files in the working tree.

name: create_branch
description: Creates a git branch.

name: suggest_worktree_path
description: Suggests a folder for a new worktree of a branch.

name: create_worktree
description: Creates a git worktree for a branch.

name: remove_worktree
description: Removes a git worktree and its folder.

name: list_worktrees
description: Lists the worktrees of a repository.

name: get_global_settings
description: Returns the global Terminator settings.

name: update_global_settings
description: Changes global Terminator settings.

name: get_workspace_settings
description: Returns the settings of a workspace.

name: update_workspace_settings
description: Changes the settings of a workspace.

name: list_extensions
description: Lists the installed Terminator extensions.

name: install_extension
description: Installs a Terminator extension, which runs its code.

name: toggle_extension
description: Turns a Terminator extension on or off.

name: uninstall_extension
description: Uninstalls a Terminator extension.

name: reload_extension
description: Reloads a Terminator extension.

name: get_extension_settings_schemas
description: Lists the settings that each extension declares.

name: get_extension_settings
description: Returns the current values of the extension settings.

name: update_extension_setting
description: Changes one global extension setting.

name: update_extension_workspace_setting
description: Changes one extension setting for a workspace.

name: list_extension_commands
description: Lists the commands that the extensions declare.

name: open_path
description: Opens a file or folder with its default macOS app, which runs an app or script.

name: detect_editors
description: Lists the code editors installed on this Mac.

name: open_in_editor
description: Opens a folder in a code editor.

name: get_app_info
description: Returns the Terminator version and platform.

name: list_notifications
description: Lists the Terminator notifications.

name: dismiss_notification
description: Dismisses a Terminator notification.

name: trigger_notification_action
description: Runs an action button of a notification.

name: get_system_metrics
description: Returns CPU and memory use of this Mac.

name: get_process_metrics
description: Returns CPU and memory use of the Terminator processes.

name: list_session_records
description: Lists the recorded sessions of a workspace.

name: set_session_description
description: Sets the description of a recorded session.

name: set_session_link
description: Links a recorded session to an issue or pull request.

name: forget_session_record
description: Deletes a session record.

name: list_tasks
description: Lists the tasks on Home.

name: create_task
description: Creates a task on Home.

name: update_task
description: Changes the fields of a task.

name: add_task_lane
description: Adds a lane to a task.

name: remove_task_lane
description: Removes a lane from a task.

name: archive_task
description: Archives a task or brings it back.

name: delete_task
description: Deletes a task.

name: merge_task
description: Merges one task into another.

name: get_agent_usage
description: Returns the token use and cost of an agent session.

name: get_thread_summary
description: Summarises the work of a task in one paragraph.

name: list_agent_asks
description: Lists the questions that agent sessions wait on.

name: list_agent_turns
description: Tells which agent sessions are in a turn.

name: list_agents
description: Lists the running agent sessions.

name: list_known_agents
description: Lists the agents Terminator can start and whether each is installed.

name: start_agent
description: Starts an agent session.

name: prompt_agent
description: Sends a prompt to an agent session.

name: steer_agent
description: Sends a message to an agent session during its turn.

name: cancel_agent_turn
description: Cancels the current turn of an agent session.

name: answer_agent
description: Answers a permission question of an agent session.

name: close_agent
description: Closes an agent session.

name: agent_history
description: Returns the updates of an agent session.

name: list_open_agent_asks
description: Lists the open permission questions of agent sessions.

name: get_home_feed
description: Returns the items of the Home feed.

name: run_home_feed_action
description: Runs an action of a Home feed item.

name: list_schedules
description: Lists the scheduled runs.

name: create_schedule
description: Creates a scheduled run.

name: delete_schedule
description: Deletes a scheduled run.

name: update_schedule
description: Changes a scheduled run.

name: pause_schedule
description: Pauses or resumes a scheduled run.

name: run_schedule_now
description: Starts a scheduled run now.

name: suggest_branch_name
description: Suggests a branch name for a prompt.

name: get_integration_status
description: Returns the connection state of the issue trackers.

name: set_my_issues_filter
description: Sets which issues count as mine in a tracker.

name: list_my_issues
description: Lists the issues assigned to me.

name: search_issues
description: Searches the issue tracker.

name: get_issue
description: Returns one issue from the tracker.

name: comment_on_issue
description: Adds a comment to an issue.

name: link_issue
description: Links an issue to a project.

name: get_issue_link
description: Returns the issue linked to a project.

name: unlink_issue
description: Removes the issue link of a project.

name: preview_issue_context
description: Shows the issue context that agents of a project get.

name: set_inject_issue_context
description: Turns issue context for the agents of a project on or off.

name: alert
description: Shows an alert to the person on Terminator Home (with Dismiss) and as a notification. An alert with the same title and source within a day replaces the earlier one.

name: start_work
description: Starts work on a prompt in Terminator, as Start work on Home does.

name: open_session
description: Shows a Terminator session in the main window.

name: open_terminal
description: Opens a terminal tab in a folder, and can run a command in it.

name: open_in_window
description: Moves a Terminator session into its own window.

name: list_quick_actions
description: Lists the quick actions that the Cmd+P panel shows.

name: run_quick_action
description: Runs a quick action that does not close or delete anything.

name: run_destructive_quick_action
description: Runs a quick action that closes or deletes something.

name: run_extension_command
description: Runs an extension command that does not close or delete anything.

name: run_destructive_extension_command
description: Runs an extension command that closes or deletes something.

name: check_for_update
description: Checks GitHub Releases for a newer Terminator and downloads it.

name: install_update
description: Restarts Terminator into the downloaded update. This closes every terminal and agent.

name: show_window
description: Shows and focuses the Terminator main window.

name: move_session_here
description: Moves this Claude Code session to a Terminator terminal tab, which runs claude --resume once this session exits. `workspace` names the Terminator workspace to open it in.
